cohort: 250 females who underwent labor and scheduled C-sections at a tertiary care hospital in Haldwani, Nainital, India
finding: The overall SSI rate was 18.0%, with a median time of occurrence on the 5th-6th postoperative day, and co-morbidity, previous cesarean section, preoperative antibiotics, and duration of surgery < 1 hour were identified as predictors of SSI.
